description.value: Subway at Kensington Square Plaza is a franchise location of the global sandwich chain, serving footlong sandwiches, wraps, and salads in Burnaby's Hastings corridor. The location supports in-restaurant dining, curbside pickup, and delivery, and accepts major credit cards. As a national chain with no documented cycling-specific amenities, its utility to touring cyclists is limited to basic food resupply.

address.value: 6626B Hastings Street Unit 146B, Burnaby, BC V5B 1S2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms address, phone, and that this is an active Subway franchise in Burnaby's Kensington Square Plaza offering pickup, delivery, curbside, and dine-in. OSM tag 'takeaway: yes' and website 'Order Pick Up / curbside pickup' confirm takeout. No evidence on the website or in OSM tags addresses bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific amenities, so those are all null. The OSM 'community' field says 'North Vancouver' but the address and website clearly place this in Burnaby — flagged as a concern.
concerns: OSM 'community' field is 'North Vancouver' but the address and website clearly place this location in Burnaby — possible OSM data error.
OSM addr:housenumber is '6626' but the website and full address show '6626B'; the 'B' suffix is part of the building number, not the unit. OSM address is slightly incomplete.
None of the three WWC required criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from the website or OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a standard Subway franchise with confirmed takeout but no verified bike parking, water refill, or washroom access — none of the WWC required criteria are confirmable from available evidence. A site visit would be needed to determine whether it meets the minimum threshold for directory inclusion.
